name: human-writing
tagline: Make AI-written Chinese read like a specific person talking — a writing and revision skill for agents
description: human-writing is a general-purpose writing and revision skill that makes AI-generated Chinese read like a specific person speaking. It ships as an agent skill that works out of the box, focusing on stripping the telltale flatness of machine prose and injecting a concrete, individual voice. The project targets Chinese-language creative and general writing workflows with Claude-style agents, and is positioned as an open, reusable skill rather than a closed product.
highlights: Turns generic AI Chinese prose into text that reads like one specific person
General-purpose creation and revision skill, ready to use out of the box
2.2k stars in under a week reflects demand for natural-sounding Chinese writing
Open agent-skill format that works across AI agent workflows
curatorNote: The Chinese-language AI writing market is huge and underserved; a skill that fixes the 'machine voice' problem in a reusable, agent-native format explains the instant traction.
